items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Speaking of Big Al... [INTERVIEWEE] Teo, Leo Teo. No, I never played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I used to go get him all the time. We used to go all over and play around there, you know.
Speaking of Big Al, can you tell us any other clarinetists you worked with? Do you remember, did you say something about the Teos a minute ago? Did you heard him when you were young?

Teo, Leo Teo. No, I never played with him. Teo, what I was trying to tell you about, that was the fellow for Warline. He used to have Mr. Fred Tudry. He used to run the piano store for Warline. Yeah, I'm not sure. Fred Tudry and them. Yeah, that was relation to the Carreras. Dr. Tudry and them. All that's relation. Gladys Carreras and all them.
